title: DualPrompt general prompt + Mirror expert prompt views
hypothesis: On tasks whose expert prompt deltas lie on a low-dimensional Givens orbit around one general prompt, a shared general prompt plus one Mirror coordinate per task preserves continual classification quality with lower actual bytes than DualPrompt's explicit expert prompts and beats same-byte scalar and shared-plus-private residual controls; unrelated deltas require private residuals.
physical_object: one task-invariant general prompt and shared expert-delta basis
mirror_coordinate: one per-task Givens angle generating an expert prompt delta
logical_multiplicity: eight task-specific expert prompt views combined with a shared general prompt

model.training_schedule: task-ordered continual stream; 200 updates on each task, evaluate every previously seen task after each task block
prompt_families: aligned Givens orbit around general prompt

retrieval: same nearest input centroid for every method, task ID hidden at inference; general prompt always applied and retrieved expert view added
controls: DualPrompt explicit: learned general prompt plus one expert prompt per task
shared general + one common expert delta hard tied
shared general + scalar per-task shared delta basis
shared general + Mirror Givens per-task view of one expert delta basis
shared general + per-task private rank-4 residual plus shared basis; all residual bytes charged
small hypernetwork from retrieved task slot to expert delta; all generator and embeddings charged
development_gate_before_fresh: For aligned family in both development seeds: retrieval >=0.95; Mirror test accuracy within 0.02 of explicit; Mirror >=0.05 above scalar and shared-plus-private rank-4 residual; actual inference payload <=0.80x explicit; no task accuracy >0.05 below explicit; otherwise fresh stays sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh aligned worlds satisfy development quality/retrieval/bytes gates and exact serialized replay; report unrelated performance, forgetting proxy by sequential task test checkpoints, view generation compute and wall-clock.
failure_gate: Any aligned development seed misses any registered gate; fresh remains unopened.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload bytes after reload
paid_objects: explicit prompts or shared expert basis

boundaries: synthetic continual classification; no DualPrompt benchmark claim
logical prompt count is not independent capacity
fixed updates do not establish capacity
fresh seeds unopened until every aligned gate passes
